exposure: full-term birth (at or after 37 weeks of gestation)
preterm birth subgroups (before 32 weeks of gestation and before 34 weeks of gestation)
cohort: Individuals aged 18-55 years with an inpatient delivery between January 2016 and September 2021, identified from the Merative MarketScan Commercial Claims and Encounters database and the Health and Productivity Management database.
finding: Preterm birth was associated with more workdays lost and costs related to medical-related absenteeism and disability in the year after childbirth compared with full-term birth.
